description.en: A one-entry index for dsh-sidebar-notes, so the plugin market's discover page can render and install it. The install-verified and risk labels the public DSH.SO index carries are audit results, not self-declared, so this index claims none of them.
description.zh: 只收录 dsh-sidebar-notes 的索引源，用于在插件市场「发现」页渲染并安装它。DSH.SO 官方索引里的「安装已验证」「低风险」是平台审计结论，不能自封，所以这里不声明这些标签。

description.en: Plain-text sticky notes in the DeepSeek Harness right Sidebar: one file per note in the session workspace, saved as you type, copyable in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏记纯文本便签：一条一个文件，落在当前会话工作区里，边写边存，可一键复制。
